metadata.title: 90s Pop Portrait with Vertical Block Typography

recipe.visualDefinition: A side-profile portrait of a woman with dark curly hair against a muted blue backdrop, featuring heavy, vertically-oriented yellow sans-serif typography on the right margin.
coreVisualRelationships: Warm magenta velvet against cool slate blue background
Bold geometric yellow text contrasting with soft organic hair curls
Vertical text alignment mirroring the subject's upright posture
Tight cropping focusing on the upper torso and head
coreInvariants: Crushed velvet texture on the garment

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject occupies the left two-thirds of the frame in a medium close-up profile.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and hands create a central focal point of soft emotion.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the subject's face, follows the hair down to the hands, then moves right to the large vertical text block.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The blue background provides breathing room on the left and top-left.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Slate blue background and deep magenta/burgundy velvet garment.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Bright yellow for all typographic elements.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Gold tones in the jewelry and highlights in the hair.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the yellow text against medium-value, desaturated background tones.
paletteRestrictions: Avoid neon greens or bright reds

letterConstructionRules: 90-degree clockwise rotation for the entire block
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single-family usage with varying scales for primary and secondary information.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy weight and condensed nature of the display text.
Provides a similar 90s editorial feel with clean terminals.
Offers the geometric precision seen in the original.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A studio portrait of a woman in profile with curly dark hair, wearing a burgundy crushed velvet dress, set against a solid muted blue backdrop. Soft lighting.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add two lines of vertical, 90-degree rotated text in a bold yellow condensed sans-serif font on the right side of the image.

verificationChecks: Is the text rotated 90 degrees clockwise?
Is the font a heavy, condensed sans-serif?
Is the garment texture clearly crushed velvet?
Is the color of the text a vibrant, solid yellow?

mustRedesign: Do not use specific artist names or titles
postGenerationChecks: Verify the presence of crushed velvet texture
Ensure text is right-aligned and yellow
recipe.reuseFormula: Portrait subject in [Garment Texture] + [Muted Background] + [Vertical 90-degree Rotated Bold Sans-Serif Typography] in [High Contrast Color].
